fact: AfriLabs lists Trustee Sas, an innovation center supporting ICT, renewable energy and agribusiness projects, and Incubateur Saboutech, a non-profit supporting SMEs and startups, as member hubs in Guinea, with no programme or cohort described.

Saboutech, described as Guinea's first incubator in Conakry, runs the #Tremplin one-year incubation and the #JePrendsMonEnvol 12-24 month acceleration, and says it has incubated 35+ startups since 2016.
